item.title: Social media personality Cowboy Cannolis to give away free cannolis in Richmond
item.description: The well-known social media personality Cowboy Cannolis will be in Richmond to give away free cannolis on Friday.

item.title: An 'all of the above' approach; Richmond city officials look at gun violence solutions in Shockoe Bottom
item.description: City officials say additional surveillance cameras and patrol officers will be in Shockoe Bottom by the weekend after a mass shooting left two people dead and seven people injured. These are on the list of several things they say they're working on to prevent it from happening again.

item.title: 'That's where we are the most useful to the community': 6 fired VSU faculty members ask to be reinstated after 'unjust' terminations
item.description: CHESTERFIELD COUNTY, Va. (WRIC) -- Six longtime Virginia State University faculty members are demanding to be reinstated after they say they were wrongfully terminated last year.

item.title: Richmond leaders to lend $14.7 million in emergency funds to Diamond District redevelopment
item.description: Richmond leaders are taking $14.7 million from the city's emergency reserve to support redevelopment of the Diamond District -- despite concerns raised regarding city code.

item.title: 20-year-old arrested after crashing stolen vehicle into Chesterfield home, causing gas leak
item.description: A 20-year-old was taken into custody after crashing a stolen vehicle into a Chesterfield County home, causing significant damage and prompting a gas leak evacuation, officials said.

item.title: 'We were robbed': Remembering Adam Oakes 5 years later
item.description: It has been nearly five years since the death of Adam Oakes, a Virginia Commonwealth University (VCU) freshman who died due to hazing in 2021.

item.title: Black cat linked to bites, scratches in Hopewell tests positive for rabies
item.description: A stray black cat linked to multiple bites and scratches in Hopewell has tested positive for rabies, per state health officials.

item.title: DHS incorrectly claims Spanberger banned all Virginia law enforcement from working with ICE
item.description: Gov. Abigail Spanberger (D) did not ban all of Virginia's law enforcement agencies from working with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), despite the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) claiming otherwise.

item.title: 'He tries to divide us': Spanberger slams Trump in SOTU rebuttal, accuses him of lies and corruption
item.description: Gov. Abigail Spanberger (D) accused President Donald Trump of forsaking the American people in favor of himself in the Democratic rebuttal to his State of the Union address Tuesday night.

item.title: Trump seeks to calm economic jitters in longest-ever State of the Union
